description: Lane A: offline job data normalization, Profile Evidence Vault and explainable matching. Stdlib-only runtime; tests need pytest. No network, no paid APIs. All stages compute from their inputs (no canned output).

jobs.import.note: Generates a seeded fictional corpus in Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/native wire formats and imports it through the real adapters. jobs.json = bare frozen JobPosting[] (every stored posting, any status); jobs_ext.json = full {posting, ext} records; jobs_import_report.json = classified rejections. count must be >= 80.

profile.claims.note: Builds the synthetic candidate's Evidence Vault and exports frozen ProfileClaim[] in internal-matching mode (contradicted and expired claims withheld). claims_vault.json = full vault incl. evidence pointers and ledger.

match.rank.note: Ranks the postings in jobs.json. A record from jobs_ext.json is used only when its posting is byte-for-byte equal to the one in jobs.json; otherwise the posting is re-normalized from the bare contract object. as_of defaults to the latest fetched_at in jobs.json (never the wall clock). matches.json = shortlist array (job_id, rank, score, score_type, ...); matches_full.json = full a-match/0.1 result incl. refusals.

features.vectors.note: {vocabulary, vocabulary_version, vectors:[{ref, entity_id, values, observed}]}; one vector per posting in jobs.json. ref is what lane C copies into AtlasPoint.source_vector_ref. observed=false means zeros are unknown, not absent.
